title: Australian Potato Hash
description: A crispy, hash-brown-inspired side dish, perfect for breakfast or brunch. Australian potatoes add a unique twist to this classic recipe.
instructions: Grate the Australian and Russet potatoes using a box grater.
Squeeze as much liquid from the grated potatoes as possible using a cheesecloth or a clean kitchen towel.
In a bowl, mix the drained potatoes with the crushed hash.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the potato mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
